note: A shaded grass pull-in on Cooks Run Road, with a driveway about 160 ft long and a site listed as 100 by 40 ft under 16 ft of overhead clearance. From PA 120 at the village of Cooks Run, take Cooks Run Road north-west about 1.1 miles, bear left to stay on it, and the site is about 0.3 mile on. Cooks Run flows in the woods close by. The agency cautions that the site is reached by remote state forest dirt or gravel roads and may not suit some low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. No table, no toilet. Pack out trash. --Claude
